steps.title: Map your USB ports
steps.text: The EFI is generated without a USB map. Build one (USBToolBox) so every port works and you stay under the port limit.

steps.title: Set up iServices (iMessage / FaceTime / iCloud)
steps.text: Check the generated Serial / MLB / SmUUID and that the serial is not in use by a real Mac.

steps.title: Check audio
steps.text: AppleALC is installed. If there is no sound, rebuild with another layout id (Customize > Audio).

steps.title: Tune CPU power management
steps.text: Verify turbo and idle states, and consider CPUFriend for a power profile.

steps.title: Make sleep and wake reliable
steps.text: Test sleep and wake, and fix any wake-from-sleep issues on your laptop.

steps.title: Check the trackpad and keyboard
steps.text: Verify the trackpad gestures, brightness keys and battery status.

steps.title: Clean up the boot screen
steps.text: Hide verbose boot and the boot picker once everything works. The Finalize options in EFI Builder do this for you.

steps.title: Harden security (SIP / Secure Boot / Vault)
steps.text: Only after everything works: consider SecureBootModel and Vault. Keep a working EFI backup first.

steps.title: Dual-boot other systems
steps.text: If you also run Windows or Linux, set up the boot entries and the clock fix.

steps.title: Plan updates
steps.text: Back up your EFI before updating OpenCore, kexts or macOS.
